messages.text: Searched the catalog · Bitfortun BS-4 Harlo B30 Magic Miner 40T

At 35¢ power is your main cost, so size matters. The B.4 is off sale right now while BitFortun finishes a firmware fix, so it's not buyable today.

What you can buy: the Magic Miner 40T, $799, best value per terahash we sell. In Eco (30 TH/s at 450W) it's roughly 325 kWh a month, about $114 at your rate — and it draws for a full 3.125 BTC block every ten minutes, year after year, plus steady sats to your own wallet.

Is this your first miner, or adding to a setup?

context.pop: What do you pay for power? I'll run the Bitfortun BS-4 numbers for where you live.
